description: Use when an agent must send funds to an ENS name or label a wallet. Input: name (e.g. ens.eth, ENSIP-15 normalized) or address. Output: JSON resolve: address, resolver, avatar/url/description/twitter/github records, contenthash (name+address: matchesExpected); reverse: primary name only if forward-verified. Ethereum mainnet registry; wildcard/offchain resolvers not followed. Example: ?name=ens.eth Price: $0.005 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: Alone: reverse lookup (primary name). With name: also check the name resolves to this address (matchesExpected)

name.description: ENS name to resolve (normalized with ENSIP-15; invalid → 400 before payment, not charged)

name: onchain_ens
title: ENS lookup: name to address with profile records, or address to verified primary name
